verdict.rationale: vLLM is a headless engine. It ships a CLI that starts the OpenAI-compatible API server, an official Docker image (vllm/vllm-openai) for deployment, an offline-inference mode, and CLI benchmark commands, all of which suit scripted, non-interactive automation. Use in CI pipelines is only implied, not documented. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples, details on non-interactive flags and exit codes for automation, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
